purpose: Teach: 栄養素/詰将棋/偶像/太陽系/オアシス/ボーイング/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは栄養素の本を熱心に読まれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to read about nutrition so carefully.
lines.style: Soft, memory-edged voice. Gentle opening, as if turning pages in time. Warm, specific — the detail matters to him. Trails slightly, letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、詰将棋がご趣味だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you, dear, you used to love tsume-shogi so much, didn't you?
lines.style: Tender redirect. Bright attention shifting to him. A small tease underneath the warmth — catching him in nostalgia, offering it back. Gentle rhythm, like familiar dance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは古い偶像を集めていらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to collect old figurines.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. Unhurried. The detail specific enough to land — he's seeing it again. Quiet conviction underneath, like he's been holding this thought.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、太陽系の図鑑をお持ちでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — you used to have that beautiful solar system encyclopedia, remember?
lines.style: Warm teasing again, with recognition. Eyes crinkling. She's not correcting him, she's matching his rhythm and gently turning it back. Patient, loving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと砂漠のオアシスのお話をしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he told me stories about desert oases.
lines.style: Voice opens with the memory — almost transported. Unhurried, specific. The story-telling quality in his delivery. Slight exhale like he's been holding this one a long time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ボーイング社の飛行機に乗られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — you flew on those Boeing planes, didn't you? For your work?
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in the voice. Light touch on the memory — not heavy. She's following his thread but also seeing him in it. Gentle persistence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは戦時下の火薬のお話を聞かせて下さったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to tell me about gunpowder during the war years.
lines.style: Deeper opening. The weight of wartime in his voice, but not grim — respectful. Slower pace. He's carrying something tender and heavy at once. Slight pause before finishing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、中東の油田のお仕事をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — you worked in the oil fields of the Middle East, didn't you?
lines.style: Same warm redirect, but with a softer landing. Recognition of something significant in his past. Gentle, almost wondering — seeing him. Closes quietly, intimately.
